text: もう　バックレて　ねてえよ

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says 'want to'; てえ is the rough, slurred way of saying it. ねてえ = 'I wanna sleep'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and'. バックレて　ねてえ = 'I want to ditch this and sleep'.
